nameSuffix.label: B-grade listing: added to the name
nameSuffix.help: Added to the end of a B-grade listing's name when a style is imported from the ERP. You can rename the product afterwards.

changesShown.label: Changed buying prices listed on "Import from ERP"
changesShown.help: How many changed buying prices (not yet seen) the "Import from ERP" page lists at once, newest first.

enabled.label: The ERP may ask the shop for top products and customers
enabled.help: When on, the ERP can ask this store, live, for its best-selling products and its customer list, only when you click "Top products" or "Customers" in the ERP. Each call must be signed with this store's own secret, and every call is logged. The ERP shows the list and does not keep it; the shop never sends it by itself. Off until you switch it on.

maxAgeSeconds.label: ERP calls: how old a signature may be (seconds)
maxAgeSeconds.help: A call signed longer ago than this, or this far ahead of the shop's clock, is refused. The contract says 5 minutes (300).

topProductsLimit.label: ERP calls: products in a "Top products" answer
topProductsLimit.help: How many products the answer holds when the ERP does not say.

customersPageSize.label: ERP calls: customers on one page
customersPageSize.help: How many customers one page holds when the ERP does not say.

maxRows.label: ERP calls: the most rows one call may ask for
maxRows.help: A call that asks for more products or customers than this gets this many.

maxRangeDays.label: ERP calls: the longest span of days for top products
maxRangeDays.help: A "Top products" call over more days than this is refused.

callsShown.label: ERP calls: recent calls listed on Keys & connections
callsShown.help: How many of the latest calls the Keys & connections page shows.

refusedPerMinute.label: ERP calls: refused calls a minute from one address before the shop stops looking
refusedPerMinute.help: Counted per sending address. After this many refused calls (wrong or old signature) from one address in one minute, every further call from it that is not yet proven is refused at once, without looking up any store, until the minute is over. Other addresses are not affected, and a call correctly signed with a store's own secret is always answered.

refusedLogMinutes.label: ERP calls: minutes between two summaries of refused calls
refusedLogMinutes.help: Refused calls are not logged one by one: the shop counts them and keeps one summary in this many minutes.

refusedShownDays.label: ERP calls: days of refused calls counted on Keys & connections
refusedShownDays.help: The Keys & connections page shows how many calls were refused in this many days.

searchMaxChars.label: ERP calls: the longest customer search
searchMaxChars.help: A "Customers" call whose search is longer than this many characters is refused.
